architecture.superseded_coarse_model: three 15 A connector-level fuses; rejected because it relies on passive sharing

authority.library: Private Librarian corpus; source bytes are not copied into public repository

checks.name: assembly identity, polarity, fit and contact seating
checks.acceptance: Exact three header/harness assemblies recorded; all contacts seated and keyed; no back-out, damage, reverse insertion or polarity discontinuity.

checks.name: branch isolation and four-wire resistance
checks.acceptance: Each of nine contact-pair paths and the effective parallel source harness/connector loop are measured hot; effective loop <=4.0 mOhm; no path backfeed or unexplained open/imbalance.

checks.name: 40 A current balance and thermal rise
checks.acceptance: 40 A continuous through all nine paths; each contact-pair path <=7 A; preferred max-min balance <=10% of mean; all connector/fuse/protection/copper/via points <= lower of component limit and 30 C rise; drops close.

checks.name: 45 A / 100 ms bounded transient
checks.acceptance: Controlled 45 A total pulse for 100 ms through all nine paths; each contact-pair path <=7 A; no uncontrolled overshoot, arc, release, damage or unsafe restart.

checks.name: independent branch protection and fault behavior
checks.acceptance: Each of nine contact-pair fault paths isolates as designed, other paths remain <=7 A, no backfeed, and V100 enable/reset/inhibit shutdown policy acts safely.

checks.name: staged source protection and first power
checks.acceptance: PISXME-P24-V100-FIRST-POWER-20260917 stages pass with polarity, OVP/UVLO, reverse, inrush, EN/PG/reset/inhibit and thermal/current evidence.

checks.name: complete source-to-J1 resistance/drop closure
checks.acceptance: Complete positive-plus-return extraction including all three harnesses/headers, branch protection, copper/vias/planes and J1 transition <=10.0 mOhm hot.

instrumentation: nine independent calibrated contact-pair current channels grouped by header plus total source current
four-wire Kelvin resistance method or calibrated low-ohm meter
differential voltage at each connector/branch and worst J1 field
thermocouples or calibrated thermal camera at all three headers, crimps, fuses, protection, copper, vias and J1 field
controlled electronic load and 45 A pulse fixture
evidence_requirements: exact header, mating housing/terminal, conductor, crimp and branch protection BOM/lot records
per-branch polarity, isolation, resistance and current-balance captures
40 A thermal and 45 A pulse raw waveforms
instrument serial/calibration/sample-rate, ambient/airflow, timestamps and operator
open_items: Exact mating 5557 housing/5556 terminal or released equivalent, conductor, length, bundle and crimp process must be bound before hardware test.
The 10% nine-path current-balance value is a PiSXMe derived prototype screen, not a Molex rating; Power Authority may tighten or explicitly revise it before hardware execution.
